outcomes.observation_source: New saved rollouts plus final valid resume tail; no inferred missing observations.

evaluation.checkpoint_selection: Each own job/stream/controller/reward phase must have updates>25. At target use its checkpoint-007569.pt; on partial progress use its actual last new update. Never select the other branch, parent or best-looking checkpoint.

material_traversal.measurement: First outbound base-projection passage from the west to east strip boundary without a side exit, with actual material-loaded feet during that passage. Uses original strip geometry and500Hz recorded states; no extra physical termination threshold or route change.

legal_route.criterion: Original base strip x[.8,2.2],abs(y)<=.6 and actual interior-foot Fz>0 at500Hz; return uses reversed boundaries. Signed credit is provisional and retracted on illegal/incomplete passage. Formal evaluator unchanged.

normalization.finite_task_channels: Always zero for every R11 training and evaluation duration

configured.video_source: On-demand rendering uses saved actual trajectory/model/result only. No automatic full-episode rendering and no new physics for videos.
configured.manifest: Compact Git paths and retained local job/episode/training locations in the existing job/index. Explicit selected bulk manifests are optional and separate.
configured.git_scope: This job's compact result files,index and handoff;source changes committed before launch. No blanket git add,no unrelated changes,no force push.
configured.status: Keep training target attainment, final evaluation, compact Git delivery, retained-local bulk data and user backup/deletion separate.

release_parts.existing_destinations: Preserve manifest/index release_tag and reuse unchanged published assets.
release_parts.server_execution_of_new_partitioning: Already executed in W35 and W36; reuse deterministic partNN destinations and existing manifests.
release_parts.scope: Existing optional selected-asset uploader only; no default automatic Release pipeline.

configured.evaluation_assets: Include every explicit evaluation attempt result/config in compact delivery; raw policy traces/arrays/videos remain local unless selected for analysis.

cleanup.authorization: 2026-11-04 confirmation: r26 retains its executed historical workflow; from W38 user periodically exports from server data disk to their own storage disk and manually deletes after backup. No automatic deletion of server research outputs or extra PC archive.
cleanup.scope: No automatic deletion of server research outputs by Codex. Historical completed cleanups remain historical facts.
preserve: current valid resume and last completed update
all active data and runtime resources
repository, source, compact records and environment
cleanup.record: Record retained-local locations and unverified user-backup status in the same job; do not invent backup completion or deletion.
cleanup.resume: Use the actual latest same-phase local resume; restore an old published checkpoint only if it is the explicitly needed state and local copy is absent.

configured.delivery_policy_source: At finish invocation use current main contract outputs.automatic_publication for delivery authorization only, record the source/policy, and preserve the frozen job execution contract for all computation/evaluation settings.

delivery_policy.scope: Current delivery policy only; frozen training/evaluation/paths/identity stay unchanged.

bulk_retention.deletion: User exports to their storage disk, then centrally deletes after backup.
bulk_retention.availability: No bulk backup or upload is claimed; historical user/deletion state is not inferred.

git_delivery: Prepared for this commit; presence on GitHub records compact delivery only. A failed push remains pending locally. Bulk data is not backed up by this push.
